summary: @onereach/idw-contracts ships install-time obfuscated payload executed via downloaded Bun runtime
details: Package declares itself as 'Shared IDW contracts, schemas and types (isomorphic)' with only zod as a runtime dependency, but package.json defines scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs checks for a local `bun` binary and, if absent, downloads the Bun runtime archive from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<platform>.zip, extracts it to a temp directory, chmod +x's it, and invokes the downloaded binary against the shipped 727KB single-line file math_init.js via execFileSync. math_init.js is heavily obfuscated with obfuscator.io fingerprints (large mixed string array `n7gIxM`, rotator function `WV8StW` that shifts array entries, randomized identifiers) and is not referenced by any code under dist/ — it exists only to be executed by the downloaded Bun binary at install time. setup.mjs itself uses `_0xXXXXXX` hex-named locals matching the same obfuscator. The install-time execution of an obfuscated payload via a freshly downloaded alternate runtime bypasses Node-based inspection, and the behavior is inconsistent with a types/schemas package that has no legitimate need for any lifecycle hook.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
